prompt: Which Antminer firmware has the best autotuning for efficiency (J/TH)? Compare vendors.
answer_text:
For **efficiency-focused autotuning**, **Braiins OS+** is the strongest overall choice for most Antminer models, especially when the goal is the lowest **J/TH** rather than maximum raw hashrate.[4][12][15] **VNISH** is also very strong and can match or exceed Braiins on some units or setups, but the sources here more consistently position Braiins as the benchmark for efficiency tuning.[3][5][14]

| Firmware | Efficiency autotuning strength | Typical J/TH outcome cited | Notes |
|---|---|---:|---|
| **Braiins OS+** | Best overall for efficiency | ~26–28 J/TH on S19 Pro; ~23.5 J/TH on S19j Pro; ~15.4 J/TH on S21 | Per-chip autotuning, open-source, repeatedly described as the “gold standard” or best-in-class for efficiency.[4][12][14][15] |
| **VNISH** | Very strong, sometimes competitive | ~27–29 J/TH on S19-class units; 16.4 J/TH on S21 in one example | Per-chip tuning and strong performance, but less consistently rated above Braiins for pure efficiency.[1][2][3][7] |
| **LuxOS** | Good, often competitive on certain models | ~25–27 J/TH in one comparison | Can be very efficient, but the provided sources do not describe it as consistently best-in-class across Antminer models.[5] |
| **Stock Bitmain firmware** | Weakest for efficiency | Example stock S19 Pro around 29.5 J/TH; S21 around 17.5 J/TH | Baseline, but lacks the same level of autotuning sophistication.[4][14][19] |

**Vendor-by-vendor comparison**

- **Braiins**: Best documented reputation for *efficiency autotuning*, with repeated claims of per-chip calibration and the best results for reducing J/TH on Antminer S-series hardware.[4][12][14][16]
- **VNISH**: Strong autotuning, per-chip optimization, and good real-world gains; on some models it performs very well, but the sources here still frame it as slightly behind Braiins in overall efficiency leadership.[1][2][3][7]
- **Luxor/LuxOS**: Competitive efficiency numbers in some comparisons, but fewer supporting details in the results provided, so it is harder to call it the best across the board.[5]
- **Bitmain stock firmware**: Stable and simple, but not in the same class for autotuning efficiency.[19]

If you want a practical rule: **choose Braiins OS+ for the best odds of lowest J/TH**, and **consider VNISH if you want a strong alternative with competitive tuning on specific Antminer models**.[3][4][5][12][14]

If you want, I can also give you a **model-by-model recommendation** for S19, S21, S21 Pro, and L7/L9.
